judged_text: `evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...teamDestinationCalendars)` no-ops when evt.destinationCalendar is null (which it is whenever eventType.destinationCalendar and organizerUser.destinationCalendar are both unset), silently dropping all team members' destination calendars for a COLLECTIVE event. A collective booking whose event type and organizer have no destination calendar configured will not be created on any team member's calendar, and no error or warning is surfaced — the API reports full success while the multi-host calendar sync is silently skipped.

adjudication.rationale: In `handleNewBooking`, `evt.destinationCalendar` is explicitly set to `null` when both `eventType.destinationCalendar` and `organizerUser.destinationCalendar` are unset (`destinationCalendar: ... : null`). Immediately after, for COLLECTIVE team events, the code does `evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...teamDestinationCalendars);`. Because of the optional chaining, this becomes a silent no-op when `evt.destinationCalendar` is `null`, dropping any `teamDestinationCalendars` gathered from additional hosts (`users.slice(1)`). The diff shows no alternate path that rehydrates `evt.destinationCalendar` in this case, so the team members' destination calendars are not propagated into the event object.
